= indented-callouts(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-06
:manmanual: Callout checks
:mansource: acdc

== Name
indented-callouts - recognize callouts in literal paragraphs

== Synopsis

 I01 café # <1>
 I02 xml <!--2-->
 I03 repeated <1><1>
 I04 escaped \<3>
 I05 interior <4> suffix
 I06 escaped XML \<!--5-->

<1> Ordinary and repeated markers.
<2> XML marker.

//-

 I07 escaped only \<1>
 I08 escaped XML only \<!--2-->

//-

 I09 automatic <.>
 I10 escaped \<.>
 I11 automatic XML <!--.-->

<.> First automatic marker.
<.> Second automatic marker.

//-

[line-comment=%]
 I12 custom % <1>
 I13 XML stays <!--2-->

<1> Custom prefix.

//-

 I14 indented <1>
I15 unindented <2>

<1> Mixed indentation retains the first space.
<2> Unindented continuation.

//-

* Parent.
+
 I16 attached <1>
+
<1> Attached literal marker.

//-

[literal]
 I17 explicit style <1>

<1> Explicit style retains its indentation.
